title: Chapter the First: The Dragon
pages: From the saga, recited at every Hollowleaf hearth:
"And the storyteller stood alone before the Dragon, in a chamber of stone deep beneath the wood. Five days he fought it. Five nights its fire raged."
"On the sixth dawn, the Dragon was no more, and the storyteller carried home its tooth as proof of his deed."
It is a stirring tale. You are standing in the chamber now. There has been no fire here in a long time.
